steps: Boil the vinegar with the wine, vegetables and spices, cool it completely and pour it over the beef. Keep it in the fridge three to five days, turning once a day.
Lift the meat out, dry it with kitchen paper and brown it hard on every side in a hot casserole. Strain the marinade, keeping the vegetables.
Fry the marinated vegetables in the same fat, add the sugar and let it catch a little colour. Pour in the marinade and bring it to the boil.
Return the meat, cover and braise over a low flame for two hours, turning it once halfway. A fork should meet no resistance.
Take the meat out and keep it warm. Stir the crumbled gingerbread and the raisins into the gravy and cook for fifteen minutes: the gingerbread dissolves and thickens it on its own.
Blend the gravy smooth and taste it for the balance of sour and sweet. Carve the meat across the grain and pour the gravy over.
